title: Alcohol-based fuel combustion improver and alcohol-based fuel
assignee_original: Guangdong Yicheng Environmental Protection Technology Co ltd
assignee_current: Guangdong Yicheng Environmental Protection Technology Co ltd
abstract: The invention discloses an alcohol-based fuel combustion improver which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-90 parts of a cosolvent, 20-30 parts of solvent oil, 1.5-5 parts of a smoke abatement combustion improver and 3.5-10 parts of a cosolvent; the cosolvent is at least one of butanol, octanol, hydrogenated anthracene oil and light oil; the solvent oil is at least one of pine nut oil, turpentine and glycerol. The combustion improver can form ideal mixed liquid with methanol, improve the flash point and the heat value of the whole fuel and promote the final combustion efficiency of the alcohol-based fuel to be obviously improved. The alcohol-based fuel combustion improver has wide raw material sources, is clean and environment-friendly, and can be industrially produced in mass. The invention also discloses an alcohol-based fuel prepared by mixing 20-40 parts of the alcohol-based fuel combustion improver and 60-80 parts of methanol, wherein each component in the alcohol-based fuel forms an ideal mixed solution by reducing the content of the methanol, and the added combustion improver component improves the overall heat value and flash point, so that the fuel has high combustion efficiency and little safety pollution.
